blocks.text:
Day 2 · After breakfast, discover the City of Kings with your guide, starting at the Love Park in Miraflores, with Víctor Delfín’s famous sculpture “The Kiss”, opened on Valentine’s Day 1993, an amazing view of the ocean and walls inscribed like pages from a book of love poems. Continue through San Isidro, the financial district, to the historic centre: the Main Square, with the Government Palace, the Municipality and the Archbishop’s Palace, and the Cathedral, with the tomb of Francisco Pizarro, then the narrow corridors of the Santo Domingo Monastery (entrances included).

Visit Casa Aliaga, one of the oldest houses in Lima, founded like the city in the 16th century on a pre-Hispanic site and still lived in by the descendants of the conquistador Jerónimo de Aliaga: its rooms are filled with art, from Cusco-school paintings to carved chests. At 18:00, the Magic Water Circuit, a remarkable park of illuminated fountains, some reaching up to 80 metres. Return to the hotel.
